name: command-center-foundation
title: Command Center Foundation
description: Scaffold the command-center scenario (React+Vite UI, Go API), build the per-page independent theming engine with 6 unique visual themes (Ground Control, Bioluminescent, Foundry, Vault, Signal Tower, Cosmos), and implement kiosk/TV-optimized UX (fullscreen, auto-cycle, hidden controls, Xbox/remote support). This is the infrastructure that all dashboard pages build on.
